## Tasks — RF mapping & fixation family

- [barsweep](tasks/barsweep.md) `active` — Passive-fixation translating-bar RF mapping; cardinal4 (4 directions, midpoint method) and rfmap12 (12 directions, filtered back-projection) regimes with online per-channel RF
- [fixate](tasks/fixate.md) `active` — Minimal fixation-training task — acquire a central fixation point and hold it for a random 0.2–0.4 s for reward; built from the scd template
- [fixate_chen](tasks/fixate_chen.md) `legacy` — Empty directory shell — the fixate copy made for the Chen lab was renamed to LGN_RF_mapping in 2026-04 and later folded into rfMap
- [RF mapping & fixation family](tasks/family-mapping.md) `active` — Passive-fixation RF mapping (rfMap, barsweep), the microstimulation detection task that uses their output (sacc_to_phosph), and the plain fixation tasks (fixate, fixate_chen)
- [rfMap](tasks/rfMap.md) `active` — Passive-fixation RF mapping with four stim types (dense achromatic, dense DKL chromatic, sparse balanced, contrast-reversing checkerboard), online per-channel STA, RF centers and a simulation mode
- [sacc_to_phosph](tasks/sacc_to_phosph.md) `wip` — Work-in-progress detection task — saccade to a visual stimulus or a microstimulation-evoked phosphene, hold fixation on no-stim trials; staircase or constant-stimuli current amplitudes via Ripple

## Tasks — detection, tokens & utility

- [Detection, tokens & utility tasks (scd family and miscellaneous)](tasks/family-scd.md) `legacy` — scd and nfl (stimulus change detection, shared scd_* files), plus the standalone tokens, human_psychophysical_threshold and reward_calibration tasks
- [human_psychophysical_threshold](tasks/human_psychophysical_threshold.md) `active` — Human 4-alternative oddity task (hue, orientation, speed, radial frequency) with QUEST threshold estimation, Eyelink fixation and keypad responses
- [nfl](tasks/nfl.md) `legacy` — The scd change-detection task (scd_* files) with block-wise trial tables mixing saturation and contrast increases and duplicated conditions
- [reward_calibration](tasks/reward_calibration.md) `active` — Utility task that delivers numTrials identical reward pulses (rewardDurationMs each) and then switches off the Run button
- [scd](tasks/scd.md) `legacy` — Stimulus change detection — hold joystick and fixation, release for a saturation increase in the cued patch, ignore foil changes
- [tokens](tasks/tokens.md) `active` — Pavlovian cue → token outcome → juice; cues predict normal-like vs uniform reward distributions; tokens_AV adds audiovisual flicker

## Tasks — gSac family

- [gSac](tasks/gSac.md) `legacy` — Original stock visually/memory-guided saccade task (Omniplex era); root of the gSac family
- [gSac family (guided saccades)](tasks/family-gsac.md) `active` — Shared design and lineage of gSac, gSac_jph, gSac_contrast and gSac_4factors, with a differs-from-parent table
- [gSac_4factors](tasks/gSac_4factors.md) `active` — Memory-guided saccade task crossing stimulus identity/salience, reward, location probability and location; actively recorded
- [gSac_contrast](tasks/gSac_contrast.md) `legacy` — Memory-guided saccade task varying DKL target/background hue contrast (salience) and reward at two mirror-image locations; predecessor of gSac_4factors
- [gSac_jph](tasks/gSac_jph.md) `active` — Visually/memory-guided saccade task for saccade and RF mapping, driven by the saccadeGUI window with Ripple spike feedback

## Tasks — joystick family

- [Joystick task family](tasks/family-joystick.md) `active` — Training lineage from "press and hold the joystick" to the cued orientation-change attention task, with a per-step "differs from parent" table
- [joystick_press_and_fixate](tasks/joystick_press_and_fixate.md) `legacy` — Training step — hold the joystick, then acquire and hold fixation on a randomly placed, randomly coloured point for reward
- [joystick_release_for_fix_and_stim_dim](tasks/joystick_release_for_fix_and_stim_dim.md) `legacy` — Detection training — release when a peripheral checkerboard patch dims (with or without the fixation point dimming too); settings files set the change:no-change ratio
- [joystick_release_for_fix_dim](tasks/joystick_release_for_fix_dim.md) `legacy` — Detection training — release the joystick when the fixation point dims (change trials), keep holding on no-change trials; hit/miss/fa/cr outcomes
- [joystick_release_for_fix_off](tasks/joystick_release_for_fix_off.md) `legacy` — Training step — on a fraction of trials the fixation point turns off silently and the subject must release the joystick to get reward
- [joystick_release_for_stim_change_and_dim](tasks/joystick_release_for_stim_change_and_dim.md) `active` — Cued covert-attention change detection ("attention task") — hold joystick and fixation, release when a peripheral checkerboard patch changes orientation; learning, opto, QUEST and psychometric variants
- [joystickPress](tasks/joystickPress.md) `legacy` — First training step — press the joystick and hold it for a random duration to earn reward; nothing is shown to the subject
- [joystickPress_playMovie](tasks/joystickPress_playMovie.md) `active` — joystickPress with a full-screen movie playing, plus Ripple spike retrieval, online PSTH plotting and sham/real opto timing during the hold

## Tasks — salience/reward choice family

- [conflict_task](tasks/conflict_task.md) `active` — Compelled-saccade choice between two DKL-colored targets (180° vs 45° hue contrast) under a three-phase left/right reward asymmetry, with target onset 0 or +125 ms after the go signal
- [numerosity](tasks/numerosity.md) `wip` — Work-in-progress one-vs-two discrimination descended from seansFirstTask, with visual trials and Ripple microstimulation trials (one or two electrodes) in spatial and temporal settings files
- [Salience vs. reward choice family](tasks/family-srs.md) `active` — Two-alternative saccade-choice tasks that pit stimulus salience against reward (SRS_Task_Smooth, SRS_mooving, conflict_task) and the dot-numerosity discrimination tasks that share their two-target layout (seansFirstTask, numerosity)
- [seansFirstTask](tasks/seansFirstTask.md) `active` — One-vs-two element discrimination; a brief one- or two-element stimulus is shown and the subject saccades to the target that matches the count; temporalOverlap sets simultaneous vs. sequential presentation
- [SRS_mooving](tasks/SRS_mooving.md) `active` — Moving-target variant of SRS_Task_Smooth; both targets resampled on a 10° circle every trial so target identity/value is dissociated from screen location
- [SRS_Task_Smooth](tasks/SRS_Task_Smooth.md) `active` — Salience–Reward–Saccade choice task; reward attached to target identity in unsignaled blocks, salience by DKL hue contrast (smooth or classic) or red luminance; eight settings variants
